race.title: Listen Live To Track Radio Mares' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: INDEPENDENT LADY shaped well on her return when second at Uttoxeter last month, beaten only by a fellow improver, and she can build on that effort to double her tally. The main danger could be Barafundle Bay , who arrives on the back of a breakthrough success over hurdles, ahead of Mavis Pike . INDEPENDENT LADY (GER) BARAFUNDLE BAY MAVIS PIKE
